courses.title: Trauma Awareness in Coaching
courses.description: A nine-week live online course from the Deep Coaching Institute, taught by Suzanne with Mark Drax, for coaches, spiritual directors and others in the helping professions. It covers how unresolved trauma shows up in clients and in the practitioner, the difference between trauma-aware and trauma-focused work, holding steady presence when someone is triggered, and knowing when to refer a client on to mental-health professionals. Sessions are recorded and carry 16 ICF continuing-education units.

flags: Trauma Awareness in Coaching: linked from her home page (https://suzannedion.com/, a 'Trauma Course 2027' banner) and the course page names 'INSTRUCTORS: Mark Drax and Suzanne Dion'. Trauma healing is allowed under the 12 Nov rule; the course is professional development for coaches and others (it lists executive and life coaches, consultants, therapists and spiritual directors), not clinician-only or a psychotherapy training, and it teaches when to refer clients to mental-health professionals rather than replacing them. A human may still judge it too close to clinical scope.
